attributes.name: Mass Displacement
attributes.powers:
At the end of any turn, discard this card to move any number of characters to any number of locations; ignore any movement restrictions.

After playing this card, if you do not have the Arcane skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane 16 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
